title: Monsoon Chuck Chili
description: A hearty, spicy chili made with ground chuck and a blend of warm spices. Perfect for a cold night.
instructions: Brown the ground chuck in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Once the meat is browned, add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the cumin, chili powder, and paprika. Cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes and chipotle peppers. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and let cook for 20-30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
